cards.text: Jesus has been staying across the Jordan (John 10:40). Meanwhile, a man named Lazarus is sick in Bethany, the village of his sisters, Mary and Martha. This is the same Mary who was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.
So the sisters send word to Jesus: "Lord, the one You love is sick." Short and clear, friend, nothing like those group chat messages that run three paragraphs and STILL forget the point.

cards.question: When Jesus hears that Lazarus is sick, He says this sickness will end in death.
Jesus says Lazarus's sickness won't end in death. What does He say the sickness is for?

answers.text: The glory of God and His Son
A test of the sisters' trust
A lesson for the whole village

cards.text: Then the story stops to make one thing crystal clear: Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus. Not "liked." LOVED.

cards.question: Jesus loves this family, and He's said the sickness won't end in death. When He hears Lazarus is sick, what does He do?

answers.text: Stays where He is for two days
Leaves for Bethany that same hour

cards.text: Then Jesus tells the disciples, "Let us go back to Judea." I bet the disciples' eyebrows shoot straight up, and friend, with eyebrows like MINE, I know a raised eyebrow when I see one.

cards.question: When Jesus says to go back to Judea, the disciples remind Him that the Jews just tried to stone Him.

cards.text: Jesus answers with a question: "Are there not twelve hours of daylight?" Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer with zero hours of daylight, so trust me, I'm listening.

cards.question: Jesus goes on: whoever walks in the daytime won't ___, because he sees by the light of this world.

cards.text: But whoever walks at night will stumble, because he has no light, and friend, I have found every cookie sheet in my bakery at midnight with my FACE. After that, Jesus tells them their friend Lazarus has fallen asleep.

cards.question: Jesus says their friend Lazarus has fallen asleep. What does He say He's going to do?

answers.text: Go there and wake him up
Let him rest a while longer
Pray for him from right here

cards.question: The disciples reply that if Lazarus is sleeping, he will get better.

cards.text: The disciples think Jesus means actual sleep, a NAP. Honestly, friend, so would I: tell me a friend is sleeping and I'm tiptoeing past with the oven timer on mute.

cards.question: The disciples thought Jesus meant actual sleep. What was He really talking about?

cards.text: So Jesus tells them plainly, "Lazarus is dead…"

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples He's glad He wasn't there when Lazarus died. Why does He say He's glad?

answers.text: So the sisters may learn patience
So the crowds may stay away

cards.question: Now that Lazarus is dead, Jesus says there's no reason for them to go to him.

cards.text: Jesus says, "But let us go to him." Then Thomas, a disciple also called Didymus, speaks up, and I respect a man with two names, since my name Dorin got carved into my handle by the family who took me home.

cards.question: Judea is where the Jews just tried to stone Jesus. What does Thomas tell his fellow disciples?

answers.text: Let us also go so that we may die with Him
Let us stay here until it is safe to travel
Let us send word to the sisters before we go

cards.text: And that's where we'll pause for now, friend. Trust me, this story is far from over.
